LUMOXIA

Ancient games, rebuilt as apps with new art and thoughtful software.

First app Mission

Mission

Lumoxia is an indie studio. The oldest games ever played are still good to play, and good art and software can bring them to new players.

Old games, new art

Games that are thousands of years old, rebuilt with new art. The rules stay true to the original and the app is easy to pick up.

Nothing extra

Simple rules, clear visuals and no ads.

Built with AI tools

AI tools are part of how Lumoxia is made, from design to code.

Coming soon

First app, coming soon

The Royal Game of Ur

One of the oldest known board games, played in Mesopotamia about 4,500 years ago. This version has new art and simple rules.

  • Eleven board designs, including one based on the original board in the British Museum.
  • Play a friend on one device, or play the computer.
  • Nine languages. Works offline, with no account, no ads and no tracking. One optional, one-time purchase opens every board and stone colour.
Coming soonto iOS and Android

Music for a 4,500-year-old game

The game has its own soundtrack. Slow, warm and a little strange, it is written to sit under a long game of dice and stones rather than to compete with it. The tracks are made with AI tools, like the rest of Lumoxia, and shaped by hand until they sound right for the board.

The soundtrack lives on Lumoxia’s Patreon page, which is also where you can help the work continue.

About

Giorgio Orsi

Maker

Giorgio is a computer scientist who has spent his career working on AI. He makes Lumoxia on his own, with AI companions and four cats, out of a long interest in ancient games.
